title: The Seeds Planted in the Wrong Row
youtube_title: The Seeds Planted in the Wrong Row | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A plain truth is kinder than a tidy secret.
summary: At a workshop bench of wood, glue, and labels, Opal is tangled up with a seeds planted in the row marked beans, not peas and almost hides it. Opal tells Uncle Idris the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
